preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 1 and 2000 inclusive.
The number of edges m is between 0 and 100000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n and 1 <= bi <= n for ai, bi in edges)
preconditions.description: Each vertex index ai and bi in the edges is between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(ai != bi for ai, bi in edges)
preconditions.description: No edge connects a vertex to itself.
The number of edge descriptions is exactly m.

postconditions.description: The minimal number of merging operations is between 0 and n-1 inclusive.
After the minimal number of merging operations, the graph is a caterpillar.
